text:
Type: tall oak chest of six drawers
Use: storing clothes and small items; bedroom, hallway, dressing area
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, minimalist
Materials: white-stained oak veneer, solid oak drawer lips
Colors: light natural oak, pale warm beige
Shape: narrow upright cabinet, two shallow top drawers over four deeper ones, each front topped by a slanted overhanging lip for a pull, raised on a recessed wooden plinth with block feet, slim footprint
Feel: warm, calm, natural, crafted
Goes with: white or cream walls, linen textiles, light wood floors; Scandinavian or Japandi bedrooms

product.name: OPPLAND
product.description: The natural grain pattern and rich texture of the wood are accentuated by first brushing the oak veneer then sealing it with a matt lacquer finish.
